_doc: Link policy (Chad 11-14): a passage/work links the first collaborator site below that holds it (the deepest link it supports), else the Anís host; never siftersearch.com in Anís output. Order = rank. Adding a site = one entry here (read by api/lib/source-links.js tierOf and api/lib/anis-links.js). links: the link styles the site supports, deepest first.
